		Dataset Description
	

BenchMAX_Math is a dataset of BenchMAX, sourcing from MGSM, which evaluates the math reasoning capability in multilingual scenarios.
We extend the original MGSM dataset by six additional languages, i.e. Arabic, Czech, Hungarian, Korean, Serbian, and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LLaMAX/BenchMAX_Math.
reputation: Part of the BenchMAX suite and used by researchers evaluating multilingual math reasoning; moderate community adoption.
